name: Model Health Trend
description: Read-only health score per saved snapshot from the inputs the snapshot holds, and a trend across all saved snapshots of the same document. Missing inputs are listed, not scored as zero.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to score. Required when connected to Revit.

rule_pack.description: Optional QA/QC rule pack. When given, error and warning rule hits count toward the score; when empty, QA is left out.

include_trend.description: Also score every saved snapshot of the same document, oldest first, with changes.

max_points.description: Latest N snapshots in the trend (1 to 500).

csv_filename.description: Optional .csv file name inside the workspace for the trend.
